summary: SurfAI v1.2 fully verified. All 3 new feature areas (push-token endpoint, Stripe cancel/resume-renewal, coach directory filters) PASS end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 new v1.2 tests + 27/27 regression tests = 42/42 green. Frontend: manage-plan flow (cancel → cancelled-pill + resume-btn → revert) and /coaches filter UI (all 4 inputs render, location=Eric returns demo, location=NoSuchPlace shows empty state) verified on mobile viewport.

minor.issue: Pre-existing: emergentintegrations CheckoutStatusResponse still rejects Stripe StripeObject metadata. Endpoint degrades to 200 with stored DB state (warning logged). Not regressed in v1.2.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1090 lines — keep growing. Recommend splitting into routers/{auth,analyses,coach,payments,push}.py.

_send_push_notification fires from add_comment without awaiting failures separately — currently fine because httpx is wrapped in try/except, but consider asyncio.create_task to avoid adding ~Expo round-trip latency to every comment POST.
cancel_renewal/resume_renewal silently no-op if cancel_at_period_end is already in target state. Consider returning idempotency hint, or 200 + {already: true}.
PushTokenUpdate accepts None to clear. Validation good (strip+empty→None) — covered.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_v12_push_stripe_filters.py (new — 15 tests covering push-token, cancel/resume renewal, coach directory filters)
seed_data_creation: Re-seeded both demo users + sessions + cleared analyses/comments/payment_transactions for the two demo users via mongosh snippet from /app/memory/test_credentials.md before the run. Coach user got cancel_at_period_end=false and expo_push_token=null fresh.
context_for_next_testing_agent: v1.2 backend + frontend stable. Push notification is best-effort (httpx POST to https://exp.host wrapped in try/except so faked tokens never break add_comment) — verified add_comment 200 still returned during regression. To rerun: re-seed via mongosh, then `pytest backend/tests/ -v`. For UI, inject demo_coach_token into localStorage then visit /profile → manage-plan-link, and /coaches for filter inputs. Empty-state text on coaches renders 'NO COACHES YET' (uppercase via textTransform).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration.
